name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2026-06-17, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
